title: A scalar local fourth-chaos counterterm must cancel the bare coupling at order N inverse squared

scalar_counterterm.form: Add c_N V_N to the fixed bare interaction g V_N, so the net fourth-chaos vacuum column is (g+c_N)W_N
scalar_counterterm.necessary_bound: Uniform control on the unchanged free form requires |g+c_N| ||(H_0+1)^(-1/2)W_N||=O(1)
scalar_counterterm.interpretation: The scalar local fourth-chaos subtraction cancels the bare quartic coupling to zero and does not construct a nonzero renormalized beta=1 interaction
scalar_counterterm.ceiling: Momentum-dependent fourth-chaos kernels, changed domains and non-form resolvent constructions remain open
